lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: Approximately 10-11 distinct high-contrast vertical line segments. Spacing is narrowest in the mid-torso region and increases toward the anterior shoulder and posterior haunch.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Vertical lines 3, 8, 9, 10, and 11 (ordered anterior to posterior) exhibit significant discontinuity, terminating mid-torso or transitioning into discrete circular blobs before reaching the ventral boundary.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A localized cluster of 3-4 distinct high-contrast white spots is positioned on the mid-lateral haunch, centered between the dorsal line and the stifle joint.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: A horizontal alignment of three circular spots is visible on the lower haunch, forming a geometric line parallel to the ground plane.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent white crescent-shaped patch at the base of the throat; distinct white spot on the lower mandible/cheek region; white transverse bands (stockings) located above the fetlocks on all visible limbs.
